about: Labelled set for the blur coverage probe (test/probe-sam-blur.test.ts). The labels are a Claude model's (claude-opus-5-5, five parallel labelling passes on 2026-11-04, each box drawn on a zoomed crop with a pixel grid and checked there), not a person's. Boxes are tight (at most about 2 px of margin), in the source pixels of the fixture as committed; left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive. plates: every licence plate, legible or not. faces: every visible face of a real person (not posters), any size; the back of a head is not a face. sure: false marks a probable plate or face too small, dark, blurred or turned to be sure. identifiers: painted plate or body numbers and similar, scored apart and never in the bar. Plate text is deliberately not recorded. Frozen before any SAM result was seen.
